# Multi-tenant CRM

*Client industry: B2B services | Completed: 2021-08-12 | Evidence id: fullstack:case:p12*

## The problem
The client was an agency juggling clients in Trello.

## What I did
I scoped the work with the client, then built the solution using Django, PostgreSQL, a Redis-backed background task queue, an in-memory cache in front of the database, containerised deployment. I kept the client in the loop with short weekly demos and wrote handover notes.

## Result
The project consolidated 40 client pipelines into one app.
